verdict.summary_en: Polish WZ (goods issue) delivery note WZ-261023-464 dated 23.10.2026 from Karton Nowak Sp. z o.o. to Soony Distribution Center Hamburg, against order 4500318754. One line: CMP-GAM-004 Cover Sleeve Grand Heist 6 (USK/PE, 65.000 PCS (65000), 65 packages, gross weight 650 kg, carrier PO 43026. Stamped RECEIVED 26.10.2026 DC-HAM and signed 'Schulz P.' by hand. No corrections, no remarks, no discrepancies recorded.
observations: Item description is cut off at the end: 'Cover Sleeve Grand Heist 6 (USK/PE' with an unclosed parenthesis.
Quantity printed as '65.000', read as 65000 under the Polish thousands-separator convention.
Handwritten signature 'Schulz P.' on the Odebrał (received by) line.
Blue RECEIVED stamp dated 26.10.2026 with DC-HAM, slightly tilted but legible.
No quantity discrepancy, damage note or overwriting visible. Page is otherwise blank below the stamp.
